scores.reasons: The site is the best-structured in the batch (clean schema, AI-friendly robots.txt) so the gap is mostly the missing booking/intake layer. A long-established single-doctor practice has real revenue but limited appetite for big projects. The intake/booking fix is quick to scope. Evidence is strong from raw HTML, robots.txt and page content.

caveats: Google Business Profile ratings, review counts and claim status could not be read for any business: google.com returned a 'systems have detected unusual traffic' bot check to the browser, and Bing returned dictionary/spam results for the same query. Listing fields are therefore marked 'unknown' or filled from on-site review widgets and third-party directories only.

Black Rose Multimedia Group and CAS AMIE are marked 'operating' on the strength of directory data plus (for CAS AMIE) a live but unpublished domain; I could not find independent evidence either is trading today. Power Up Consulting is marked 'not found' for the same reason.
casamie.com is linked to CAS AMIE Freelance Design Studio from its Yellow Pages listing, not confirmed on the site itself - inference, moderate confidence.

brunswickfamilydentistry.com returned HTTP 403 to the headless browser but served full HTML to a plain HTTP fetch, so its review is based on page source and readable text rather than a rendered desktop/phone screenshot.

Dr. Karim Jarjoura (named in the batch for Dental Health Associates) did not appear on the North Brunswick location page I read, which lists Dr. Natalie Nebblett as orthodontist; the batch's naming may refer to another DHA office.
data_gaps: No Google/Yelp star ratings or review counts captured for any of the nine businesses (search engines served bot checks).
No access to Google Maps/GBP details such as claimed status, categories, photos or Q&A for any business.
LinkedIn employee counts were not opened (login wall avoided), so headcount for AITA and Coastal is inferred from office and service footprint.
Financials, current pricing and actual booking volumes are unknown for every business; ability_to_pay scores are inferences from footprint and ticket size.
